tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows mild anemia (low hemoglobin and hematocrit) with normal red cell indices, suggesting normocytic, normochromic anemia. Platelet count is normal, but both mean platelet volume and platelet distribution width are elevated, indicating increased platelet size and variability, which may reflect increased platelet turnover or activation. Further evaluation for underlying causes of anemia and platelet changes is recommended.
